GATES.md invariants: INTERACTABILITY_MUST_BE_OBSERVED_SEPARATELY_FROM_CONTROL_VALUE (a control's ON/OFF value and its ENABLED/DISABLED state are independent evidence fields; action authority requires both) and CONTROL_ACTION_REQUIRES_ACTIONABLE_PHASE (visible presence grants no authority for semantic control actions such as Auto or Speed; a fresh observation must establish an actionable phase and an enabled control, otherwise remain fail-closed).
inferences: What may be clicked now: no semantic control action. Auto must wait for the recorded clickable window AND a fresh read showing enabled styling; the speed badge has no grounded actionable claim (display-only), and no other control on the frame carries a recorded actionable claim here.
